notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Awaken the Ages using convoke without paying mana.
description:
Cast Awaken the Ages using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Strife Scholar.
When Strife Scholar enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
